title: Modewise cycle and Pythagorean repair
statement: Decompose the first unresolved arc-covariance edge into cycle modes or information increments and prove a summable modewise estimate, or certify a smallest adapted signed obstruction.

signature.representation: Fourier modes of cyclic arc incidence cross-checked against conditional Pythagorean increments
signature.state_or_invariant: Mode energy coupled to local Schur residual decay rather than raw arc length
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The signed off-diagonal mode sum is absorbed by the total conditional information gain with a universal coefficient.
signature.target_implication: Absorption repairs the first bad edge in R121 and completes the conditional half-window route to C051, then C050.
signature.known_failure_mode: A mode bound that ignores adaptation or local Schur constraints may merely repackage the same O(n) scalar Hardy loss.
signature.verifier_class: symbolic cyclic-mode identity plus exact small-complement and equicorrelation controls
